name_zh: 共转坐标中的时间修复
formal_object: Native predicted mesh Y_t; model/geometry-derived rotations R_t in SO(3), translations c_t; anchor X; body-frame residual u_t=R_t^T(Y_t-c_t)-X.

operations.condition: R_t,c_t are estimated from permitted inputs and geometry
operations.output: Factor out rigid motion before smoothing

operations.condition: Rotations are orthogonal; transform is invertible at fixed R,c
operations.output: Temporal repair acts on deformation, not pose

derivation_steps.statement: For a rigid sequence Y_t=c_t+R_t X, u_t=0 at every t.
Solve a declared anchored temporal repair for u, then reconstruct Y'_t=c_t+R_t(X+u'_t).
derivation_steps.justification: The coordinate transformation is invertible while R,c are fixed.

derivation_steps.statement: An operator mapping zero to zero leaves the exact rigid sequence unchanged, even for time-varying rotations.
derivation_steps.justification: This invariance is absent from smoothing world coordinates across different R_t.

assumptions: Rigid factors may be wrong or insufficient for articulated objects.
Factor estimation and downstream repair share the same tuning/cost budget as controls.
Differentiating through refitted R,c defines a different algorithm; the present subproblem freezes them.
No GT pose, cameras or evaluation ICP transforms enter inference.
method_expression: Fit a legal rigid/body-frame decomposition, temporally repair only u, and reconstruct using the unchanged estimated pose.
distinguishing_prediction: Pure rigid rotation/translation should be preserved by construction; improvement versus world smoothing should depend on pose variation rather than merely noise magnitude.
falsifier: Reject if inferred rigid factors are unstable or a equal-cost rigid-aligned Gaussian baseline gives the same native performance.
closest_alternative: Classical corotational deformation and pose-factored smoothing; STAC local rigid fitting; SFG root-space local/global decomposition. Treat basic pose factoring as a strong simple baseline, not a new contribution.
decisive_comparison: World-coordinate smoothing, rigid-aligned simple smoothing and the declared body-residual operator under the same fitting/repair budget; full native metrics.
operational_delta: An invariance-preserving coordinate choice; a basic rigid-aligned smoother may already close the gap.
feasibility_and_cost: Rigid fits and banded temporal solve; native pose-estimation reliability is unknown.
structural_signature: Time filtering after factoring pose, not spatial rotation synchronization.
algebra_review_basis: Exact rigid substitution checked and the frozen-coordinate condition stated. No guarantee for incorrectly fitted articulated motion.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
